text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor m-o-n-i-t-o-r-e-d the s-u-p-p-l-i-e-r s-a-l-a-r-y p-a-y-r-o-l-l-s to i-d-e-n-t-i-f-y w-a-g-e s-t-a-l-k-i-n-g and l-o-c-k-e-d the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-t-u-n-n-e-d r-e-p-o-r-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n g-a-t-e.
2) the actor c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d h-o-s-p-i-t-a-l p-a-t-i-e-n-t c-h-a-r-t-s for r-a-n-s-o-m w-a-r and d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-d the d-i-s-c-s-k, r-e-t-a-i-n-i-n-g a s-h-a-d-o-y i-m-a-g-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the e-n-c-r-y-p-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor i-n-f-i-l-t-r-a-t-e-d the f-a-c-t-o-r-y l-o-c-a-l s-e-r-v-e-r-s for c-o-r-p-o-r-a-t-e t-r-a-d-e s-e-c-r-e-t-s and i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d a b-a-c-k-d-o-o-r, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a h-i-d-d-e-n s-y-s-t-e-m l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-v-a-s-i-o-n d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n s-c-a-n.
4) the actor s-c-a-v-e-n-g-e-d the d-r-i-v-i-n-g r-o-u-t-e d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e for i-n-t-e-l-l-i-g-e-n-c-e a-g-g-r-e-g-a-t-i-o-n and c-l-o-n-e-d the r-e-p-o-s-i-t-o-r-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-h-o-n-y c-o-m-m-i-t h-i-s-t-o-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-d-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the actor s-c-a-t-t-e-r-e-d m-a-l-w-a-r-e a-c-r-o-s-s the u-n-i-v-e-r-s-i-t-y c-l-o-u-d n-e-t-w-o-r-k and d-e-fo-r-m-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s p-r-o-v-i-s-i-o-n s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-aint-e-d i-m-a-g-e s-t-a-c-k w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-a-t-c-h v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
